snippet.title: Nightmare Frontier | Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Overcome your fears with shotgun therapy.

Behold the first-ever Tactical Extraction Looter where you pit your courage and leadership against fears made manifest: the Dreadweavers.
Lead a band of scavenger roughnecks into a devastated boom town of the alternative 1900s.
Get in, face the monsters, grab what you can carry and get out. Alive.

🎮 Play now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310950/Nightmare_Frontier/
